messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I'm assembling the release notes for next week's docs push. Need a final pass on the announce copy and one remaining known-issue bullet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

jonathan: on it. I'll rework the announce intro to be more user-focused (switch from 'we launched' -> 'you can now').

priya: I can run the link-checker and sweep for broken redirects later today. Anything specific to prioritize? :eyes:

elaine: thanks. Priority: the SDK snippets (section 2) and the migration guide links. We had 2 redirect changes this sprint that might have snuck into examples.

sam: FYI the Python SDK snippet still uses `client.generate` — the new API is `client.text.generate` in the latest SDK. Quick example that needs updating:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Summarize the following...")
print(resp.text)
```

jonathan: ah good catch, sam. I'll replace with the new pattern and add a note about the breaking change in the changelog bullets.

priya: link-checker run started. Found 3 301/302 redirects and 1 404 in the migration guide TOC. I'll list them in the PR comments.

docs-bot: deploy-preview for PR #842 is ready: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:

elaine: perfect. Can we also add a short 'known issue' about token-metering mismatch when using dedicated routing + prefix cache? The engineering note is in the ticket: internal/INF-1198. We just need a one-line user-facing callout.

jonathan: draft suggestion: "Known issue: Token accounting may show slightly higher usage for short bursts with dedicated routing + prefix caching enabled. We're tracking a fix; no impact to output correctness." Thoughts?

sam: succinct and clear. Maybe add expected ETA? If we don't have a reliable ETA, leave it generic: "investigating; expected in next few releases" might be risky. I'd omit ETA.

elaine: agreed. Leave ETA out. Add link to support doc: https://support.redwood.ai/kb/token-accounting for more detail.

priya: finished link-check run. I left inline comments on the PR: migration-guide TOC (old slug), embed-streaming example (301 -> new path), and one dead internal trace link (404) — replaced with support article.

jonathan: I'll push the snippet edits and the announce copy in one commit to keep the release notes cohesive. Will ping when ready for review.

elaine: awesome, thanks all. If we can get reviews before EOD I'll merge and trigger the relnotes publish job tomorrow morning. :shipit:
